text:
Independent review of run r-20260919T112327157134-trcr-class-free-containment (plan nova:topology-read-containment-and-rebank, section 1), performed in an isolated worktree at base c11eea7f against head 6a31b665. All readings below were taken first-hand; none is quoted from the run's own reports without re-execution.

SCORE goal_fidelity: 18
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: Both fence claims hold under re-execution: the class-free read on the persisted row-16 fixture now publishes the axis-connected centre-column contact [0.195244, -0.011793] at 0.25673503858584695 Wb with diverted 0.0, identical to the class-pinned limited read, and containment is resolved inside each pass (containment_required None for a class-free read, re-evaluated against that pass' own X-point level) so the two passes cannot share one pass' answer. The criterion ranked = polarity*(screened[2] - x_point_flux) > 0 is physically derived rather than a narrower form that happens to pass: it honours the wall contact exactly where the contact is reached before the saddle going outward from the axis, which is the same ordering boundary()'s own mode_index selection over [x_flux, w_flux] applies. The rejected jnp.any(eligible) form is measured, not merely asserted: gate1.log moves the diverted position contract 0.1594393405540552 m and the diverted-single-null contact 0.024815630484964643 m against a 0.02473095024234173 m median panel, so accepting it would have converted a diverted read into a limited-looking one.

SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: The gate was exercised first-hand rather than read: one all_debug job, JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu, shared interpreter directly (no uv on the compute node), the four named files, 34 passed in 320.80 s, exit 0 (/home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20260919T120129481194-review-of-trcr-class-free-containment/gate-review.log), reproducing gate2.log's 34 passed in 317.56 s. The receipt's contour_min_wall_distance_m carries one meaning across rows (before 0.873510 and 0.873531, after 0.001252 with measurement_status persisted-fixture-regenerated; row 17 null with not-regenerated, explicitly declared), and the SVG read as text with each panel calibrated on its own wall path (max calibration error 7.2e-9 m) puts each contact marker exactly on its receipt contact ([0.605054, 1.728082] before, [0.195244, -0.011793] after, the inboard centre-column contact on the boundary), beside 3 faint strokes, a glyph-rendered detached label in both panels, the wall, and the null markers. The pre-fix defect reproduces independently in a clean shadow tree at base 780b4f63 whose provenance assertions hold (nova resolves under the shadow path, pre-fix-code False): class-free publishes [0.59908082, 1.72808158] at 0.25850360061597305 Wb with diverted 1.0 while the pinned limited read publishes the contact at 0.25673504 Wb with diverted 0.

SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: The diff 780b4f63 to 6a31b665 touches exactly the nine declared paths and nothing else, the reviewed worktree is clean at 6a31b665, the run's commits are linear and reachable from the merged head c11eea7f, and no shared index, peer plan or sprint state was touched; the sole evidence fence not met on my count is a figure-stroke count claim (see FINDING), a reporting defect within the declared scope rather than an out-of-scope write.

SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: The behavioural change lands with its contract test (test_persisted_class_free_read_publishes_the_axis_connected_contact asserts the class-free read against the persisted fixture, within one pitch of the contact and beyond one pitch from the detached lobe), the four commits each carry a body and no attribution trailer, the evidence record and the plan landing are committed and pushed in the same session, and the gate logs persist on disk under the run's reports directory so the negative control survives the session. The one residual durability gap is declared: the optional x_point_flux argument defaults to None and yields containment_required False for a caller that omits it, which is deliberate for the contact-only caller but is not asserted anywhere.

SCORE fit: 17
JUSTIFICATION fit: The change answers the plan's class-free containment question at the seam that owns it and leaves the two declared follow-ons (row 17 regeneration, and the 0.032412 Wb route disagreement between the before rows' published boundary level and the corrected route's level) as follow-ons rather than silently absorbed; the deduction is that the figure's before-panel annotation pairs a gap metric measured at the row's containment-aware contour_reference_flux_wb with a boundary stroke drawn at that row's own published boundary_flux_wb, so the two printed numbers describe contours 0.032412 Wb apart and a reader measuring the drawn red contour would not reproduce the printed gap.

FINDING docs/figures/null-identification-authority/limited-touch/row-16-before-after.svg:1 The run manifest's artifact verification line quotes "8 separatrix strokes", but the file's eight #cc0000-coloured paths are 2 boundary-drawing strokes (linewidth 1.5, one per panel: 29 and 55 vertices, each a single subpath) plus 6 marker glyph paths (contact-marker edges at linewidth 1.2 and the null-marker glyphs); the figure's behaviour is correct, but the quoted count conflates colour with drawing role and will mislead any reader spot-checking the fence's "eight boundary strokes on the axis-enclosing component" against the file.
FINDING docs/figures/null-identification-authority/limited-touch/row-16-before-after.svg:180 The before panel's corner annotation prints "boundary 0.286946 Wb" (the row's published wall-zone level, boundary_flux_wb in the receipt, drawn as that panel's red boundary stroke) directly above "contact gap 0.873510 m", and the gap was measured at the row's containment-aware contour_reference_flux_wb (0.25673503858584695 Wb); the two numbers in one annotation therefore describe contours separated by the recorded 0.032412 Wb route disagreement, so the label reads as the gap of the drawn stroke when it is not.

VERDICT accept. The landed criterion is the right one rather than a narrower fix that happens to pass, and both fence claims about the class-free and class-pinned readings agree on the persisted fixture under independent re-execution. Neither finding changes the landing; both are reporting/annotation defects that a reader would hit before a solver would.
